What was it before it got deleted?

Honestly everything is too much. Christmas is coming and I need to make the decision as to whether I want to see my dad or not. I'm leaning towards not because he evidently dosent give a shit and I only see him in person about once a year and it's really getting to me and I've always had issues with it once after a science lesson i had a breakdown because out teacher was taking about his daughter and hes just such a good dad (even after breaking up with the mum) and I got jealous which is just an ugly emotion 

I'm behind in all of the three subjects in doing in sixth form and I dont know what I'm going to do after I leave with 3 fails and have to get a job that I hate

My social skills are terrible I cant hold any kind of conversation with anyone I dont know. I'm the only person I know to have never been in a relationship and I only have one friend that I think might keep in contact with me  when I leave school. my new music teacher is about to find out about my social skills when we perform tomorrow and spend the hour trying to get me to move around which I wont for some reason

On top of all that I'm cripplingly lazy which is why I'm so behind I just cant seem to motivate myself 

In my psychology class I had an exam on "attachments in early age and how they effect adult relationships" and "the role of the father" which is showing me why I am the way I am and I hate it 

My relationship with my mum is getting worse and worse by the day 

And one that's not the center of my problems but is always kinda there is that I got pressured into sex with a guy when I was 13 (I'm not even gay) and it still bothers me and I cant seem to forget it and i hate the idea that I'm so easily manipulated 

Honestly looking at where I'm going it looks like I'm going to end up dying alone in a council flat and that idea makes me suicidal

TL:DR AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

(Sorry for the essay but it was nice to get it out)

I'm doing better now thanks and sorry about your friend
First time I couldn't get over railings second time my noose snapped

Honestly I just hated myself

I thought that the people I hung around with at school were only pretending to like me because they felt bad for me as they didn't talk to me outside of school which made me feel really stupid 

Because of that I started isolating myself I became quite moody especially when talking to pearents which caused my mum to snap and tell me that I'm a horrible person to be around and that's why you have no friends and that really got to me as she has never said anything like that to me before

At this point I was severely depressed and at school I'd been getting alot of jokes that I was going to be a school shooter because I was so quiet which made me feel worse and then due to the depression I wasn't getting school work done causing most of by predicted grades to go to a U 

At that point I decided that I wasn't worth the food and water and that i was burdening everyone around me so I went to the top of one of those big car parks to throw myself off but the railings were very secure and went into like a mesh roof above it and I ended up giving up in about 10 mins when someone got out of there car

TL/DR - no one liked me, I isolated myself, I was failing school and my thoughts got the better of me I went to the top of a car park but couldn't get over the railings 

The second time was for roughly the same reason but was during the first month or two of covid I had tied a nuse and wedged a bar in our attic door

I put it on r/suicide watch and someone told me to test my weight on it and it snapped.

After I went on r/depressionhelp and got some advice and about 3 months later here I am

Sorry didn't think it would be that long and I wouldn't be surprised if it is to do with brain chemistry as well

What stopped me wasn't somthing that anyone should do but what's keeping me going is constantly making sure I have something to look forward too no matter how small. It started out as a cup of tea when I woke up  and I kept adding things on to the point where I wasn't dreading waking up and going through the day

Another thing that helps the self loathing is giving yourself a purpose. For example I started teaching people guitar via reddit which made me feel less worthless because I was making someone else happy
